name: Intelligence Sharing (MISP, STIX/TAXII)
description: Sharing and receiving threat intelligence using standardized formats and platforms. Covers STIX/TAXII protocols, MISP administration and event management, traffic light protocol (TLP) handling, intelligence sharing communities, and ensuring interoperability of intelligence products across organizational boundaries.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to structured threat intelligence sharing

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the purpose of intelligence sharing and common standards and protocols
evidence: Can describe STIX, TAXII, and their roles in intelligence sharing
Understands TLP markings and their handling requirements
Aware of MISP and its role as a sharing platform

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Creates and receives intelligence in standard formats under supervision
evidence: Creates MISP events with proper attributes and tagging under guidance
Produces basic STIX bundles from engagement findings
Applies correct TLP markings to intelligence products
Sharing decisions reviewed by authorized personnel

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently manages intelligence sharing workflows and community participation
evidence: Manages MISP event lifecycle (creation, correlation, publication) across 3+ sharing actions
Produces and validates STIX 2.1 objects for automated sharing
Participates in sharing communities with appropriate handling of received intelligence
Sharing products and decisions pass QA and policy review

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Administers sharing platforms; develops integrations; mentors analysts on sharing tradecraft
evidence: Administers MISP instances including taxonomy management, feeds, and synchronization
Develops TAXII server/client integrations with defensive tooling
Evaluates and onboards new sharing communities and feeds
Mentors junior analysts on sharing standards, TLP compliance, and community norms

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Architects sharing infrastructure; defines sharing policy; trains teams
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's intelligence sharing architecture and policy
Develops custom MISP modules, galaxies, or taxonomies
Contributes to standardization efforts (OASIS CTI, MISP project)
Trains teams and establishes sharing community relationships

assessment_methods.description: Given engagement findings, produce a properly TLP-marked MISP event with STIX export suitable for community sharing
Audit MISP events and STIX packages for data quality, proper marking, and compliance with sharing agreements

mitre_attack.note: Covers sharing of intelligence encoded as ATT&CK-mapped STIX objects
